messages:
Deploy Bot: terraform plan for release/v1.18 -> staging scheduled to run in 30m (staged across us-west-2 / us-east-1 / eu-west-1). Reply 'hold' to pause, 'pin' to require provider pin, or 'skip' to skip staging.
Maria K.: Heads-up: this plan touches TGW attachments + Route53 records + an IAM role (org-deploy). If records are replaced we could see brief DNS flaps. Recommend pinning provider to hashicorp/aws 4.2.0 and adding lifecycle create_before_destroy to route53 resources.
Sam R.: Agreed. I'll update module-network refs. Suggest staggered apply: per-region canary -> 10m soak -> proceed. Abort if we see >3% error rate or 5xx spike.
Priya V.: Add explicit rollback triggers: 1) route table misconfig >0 failing routes, 2) 5xx spike >3% relative to baseline, 3) IAM role cannot be assumed by services. Rollback plan: snapshot tfstate and restore previous snapshot if needed (prefer over ad-hoc destroys).
Luis (oncall): Make sure we snapshot S3 tfstate and tag the snapshot with release/v1.18. I'll be on-call during the window; ping me for manual rollback.
Alex T.: I'll create a canary job that applies only module.tgw and module.r53 in us-west-2. During window we'll run: `terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.tgw -var 'region=us-west-2'`.
Maria K.: Also ensure versions.tf has: `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.2.0" } }`. Compatibility tests passed in my local.
Deploy Bot: plan started: /ci/infra/pipelines/1959876543/plan. Plan summary: 3 Route53 record replacements, 1 TGW attachment creation, 2 IAM updates. snippet:
```
+ aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.tgw_attach
~ aws_route53_record.app
~ aws_iam_role.deploy_role
```
Sam R.: Route53 replacements are risky. We'll limit canary to us-west-2 only. If canary is clean after 10m, ops will ACK and we'll proceed to us-east-1. No global apply without a manual go.
Priya V.: I added a circuit-breaker in the rollout script: if alarm hits, we auto-pull state (`terraform state pull > snap.json`) and notify SRE. That gives us a clean snapshot to restore.
Luis (oncall): ACK. I'll watch metrics and cloudwatch alarms. If we need to abort, @oncall will run the snapshot restore procedure.
Alex T.: Branch `release/v1.18-infra-pin` created with provider pin + module ref bump. PR opened, requesting review from @Maria.
Maria K.: Reviewing PR. Also added `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on route53 entries to reduce DNS flap.
Sam R.: Final: change window approved 2025-09-14 15:30-16:30 UTC. Canary plan: us-west-2 -> 10m soak -> us-east-1 -> 10m soak -> eu-west-1. Rollback criteria as above. Tagging @deploy-team.
Deploy Bot: apply scheduled. Canary will start in ~5m. Logs: <https://ci.internal/infra/1959876543|ci run> :eyes:
Deploy Bot: canary apply completed successfully. Monitoring for 10m soak now.
Sam R.: Canary looks good on metrics (no 5xx bump, latency flat). Proceeding to us-east-1 canary.
Maria K.: Thanks all. Reminder: snapshot is stored at s3://redwood-terraform-snapshots/release-v1.18/snap-1959876543.json
Deploy Bot: full rollout in progress, will post final status when complete. :thumbsup:
